title: Failure sample headers sidecar
description: Response headers + capture metadata for a challenge/WAF page that arrived instead of a case. Paired with a same-stem .html file containing the challenge body. Saved at output/failure_samples/challenge_{court}_{year}_{num}.headers.json.

is_challenge.description: Whether the response was classified as a challenge/WAF page. True in normal operation — the failure_samples/ directory only holds classified challenges.

truncated.description: Whether the paired .html body was truncated at capture time.

body_bytes.description: Length of the captured .html body in bytes.

headers.description: Response headers as returned by the upstream. Header names lowercased.
